las-s17/effects/hit-stages/atlas-s17.mineral-sand-suppression/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s17/weapon.pack.ts","src/combat/sword-combat.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":["binding:atlas-s17:sword-stage:1"]},"designNotes":["矿砂镇压排在凝水膜之后，但没有必须已有水膜的触发条件；它也不会消耗水膜。","镇压与水膜分别计时；同名镇压刷新不叠层。坤衡可消费镇压强化自己的剑击，消费后目标失去镇压的移动与行动修正，但沉潮水膜仍在；本工序不降低防御或生成地面陷阱。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s17","effects","hit-stages"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s17","name":"沉潮"}}}}
